duplicate_assessment_methodology.technical_details: Tracks uint64 row hashes in streaming hash sets across chunk boundaries. This achieves high collision resistance for multi-million row datasets without storing full raw records in memory. It is framed as a high-confidence hash assessment rather than a memory-exhaustive byte-by-byte equality guarantee.
duplicate_assessment_methodology.intra_file_definition: Duplicate records occurring within the same CSV file.
duplicate_assessment_methodology.cross_file_definition: Records in a CSV that duplicate records already observed in preceding CSV files.
duplicate_assessment_methodology.within_chunk_definition: Lower-bound check counting duplicates strictly within isolated chunk buffers.
